template.name: {value}_events_open
template.desc: {value}: the GM's Events pane open in the Visuals drawer, no brush out: the header, the brushes the table can take (12 px between groups, 4 px inside one), no intro paragraph, the look's Cancel and Save stepped out, Add token gone from under the glass

steps.name: 1280x720_events_biome
steps.desc: 1280x720: Biome picked with its first biome, the drawer still open while the GM picks, the ring hovering at the drawer's edge and passing under its glass (no press yet), the hint bar led by Biome's keys and naming it

steps.name: 1280x720_events_paint
steps.desc: 1280x720: Paint picked: its gesture line and the surface tiles by group, the default path picked and the brush out

steps.name: 1280x720_events_water
steps.desc: 1280x720: Water picked: WaterToolPane under the Brushes tiles, its own header hidden

steps.name: 1280x720_events_bridge
steps.desc: 1280x720: Bridge picked: BridgeToolPane's kinds under the Brushes tiles

steps.name: 1280x720_events_sculpt
steps.desc: 1280x720: a live Sculpt raise held on the board: the drawer stepped aside at the press, the ring on the rising ground, the canopy over it open card by card with trunks kept, the hint bar led by Sculpt's keys

steps.name: 1280x720_events_raised
steps.desc: 1280x720: the raise released, the brush still out: the canopy closed again over the new mound

steps.name: 1280x720_events_put_away
steps.desc: 1280x720: the brush put away after the raise: the board whole, the play hint row back, the Events rail item no longer tinted

steps.name: 1280x720_events_undone
steps.desc: 1280x720: after Ctrl+Z (PlayEvents.undo): the ground back as it was, the 'Raise undone' toast

steps.name: 1280x720_events_clearing
steps.desc: 1280x720: a 9 m Clear held mid-sweep: the drawer aside, the canopy open over the ring card by card, trunks standing

steps.name: 1280x720_events_cleared
steps.desc: 1280x720: the Clear released, a large edit: 'Cleared for everyone at the table' with Undo on one line, the canopy whole again round the swath

steps.name: 1920x1080_events_brush_out
steps.desc: 1920x1080: Thin held on the board's right half, where the drawer stood: the drawer aside, the ring and the open canopy, the hint bar led by Thin / Clear's keys

steps.name: 1280x720_events_night
steps.desc: 1280x720: the Events pane over the darkest board the game makes (outdoor_night, the sun off): glass text and tiles over a near-black map, the Sculpt ring on the board

steps.name: 1280x720_events_player
steps.desc: 1280x720: a player's view of the same table (staged: the GM's Visuals drawer concealed, the GM's HUD buttons hidden and the GM's toasts dismissed): the cleared swath, no Events pane, no brush, no toast

steps.title: Events pane
steps.intro: The GM's live brushes in play (cards gm-events, gm-events-2a).
